summary.flaw: Consumers previously treated the mere presence of a GOAL_COMPLETED event record as sufficient proof of success without checking terminal status or gate approval.
summary.remedy: Enforced strict semantic checks across all evaluators and telemetry consumers.

audited_consumers.legacy_check: verdict = 'PASS' if (launcher_attestation['is_verified'] and completed_event and presented_event) else 'FAIL'
audited_consumers.repaired_check: Requires completed_event['data']['status'] == 'SUCCESS' AND completed_event['data']['completed'] is True AND gate approval verdict APPROVED
Distinguishes terminal success (GOAL_COMPLETED with completed=True) from failure (RUN_TERMINATED)
Passes res.task.contract and validates AuthoritativeCompletionGate before emitting GOAL_COMPLETED

audited_consumers.legacy_check: Emitted GOAL_COMPLETED unconditionally for any status
audited_consumers.repaired_check: Drops emission if status != 'SUCCESS' or gate rejects; delegates to RUN_TERMINATED

audited_consumers.legacy_check: Emitted GOAL_COMPLETED for failed tasks if status was passed as string
audited_consumers.repaired_check: Strictly gates status=='SUCCESS' and emits RUN_TERMINATED on rejection
